title: Can I BEAT FPS Chess?
summary: iwantcheckmate plays FPS Chess: a chess game where every capture attempt becomes a first-person-shooter duel between the two pieces in a 3D arena (Victorian red-walled room).
rules: Pieces move like normal chess on the board.
When a piece attempts a capture, both pieces fight a first-person duel (intro card e.g. 'Rook vs Knight'); the duel winner keeps/takes the square.
evidence: Frame line: 'Captures are resolved by first-person shooter duels', duel intro cards.
